description: Configure Jolly Lobby Track to run in Kiosk (Self-Service) mode for unattended visitor registration. Navigate to the program options/settings, enable Kiosk Mode, and set the Welcome Message to 'Welcome to Summit Coworks'. Also set the subtitle/instruction text to 'Please sign in using the form below'. Save the settings and ensure the Kiosk screen is active or ready.

metadata.expected_subtitle_text: Please sign in using the form below
